profile.name: Dinesh Babu R

projects.name: Agentic AI Resume Agent - MuleSoft MCP Server (MCP Bridge & Connector)
projects.description: Built a dual-mode MuleSoft integration application exploring two agentic AI integration approaches - MCP Bridge (wrapping an existing REST API) and MCP Connector (native MCP Server), both exposing structured resume data as AI-queryable tools via natural language.
keyAchievements: Implemented MCP Bridge approach via Anypoint API Manager Agent and Tool Instances, wrapping an existing RAML 1.0 REST API (10 endpoints) as an MCP-compatible agent enabling AI clients to query without code changes

Configured 6 inbound MCP policies on the MCP Bridge instance: MCP Support, MCP Tool Mapping, MCP Schema Validation, MCP Transcoding Router, MCP Tools Progressive Disclosure, and MCP Payload Optimization via Anypoint Omni Gateway
Implemented MCP Connector approach using MuleSoft MCP Connector with 9 tools over Streamable HTTP transport, enabling AI clients to query structured resume data conversationally
Designed RAML 1.0 API specification with APIKit Router pattern covering profile, experience, skills, certifications, achievements, and full-text keyword search endpoints
Deployed to CloudHub 2.0 and validated with Postman (HTTP & MCP transport); both approaches verified against MCP Inspector, Claude Desktop, and VS Code MuleSoft Developer Agent (Agentforce)

interests: Continuous upskilling in cloud-native architectures, agentic AI integration (MCP), API security (OAuth 2.0, mTLS), Runtime Fabric, and enterprise integration governance
Interested in financial markets, technology trends, and digital innovation in APAC
